QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Let the keyboard send guided commands. Stays as you leave it across flights and restarts; only this switch turns it off. Keys still do nothing unless the vehicle is flying in Guided.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Keyboard control

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: headingLeftKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that turns the aircraft left by one heading step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Turn left

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: headingRightKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that turns the aircraft right by one heading step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Turn right

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: headingBankLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Largest bank angle the aircraft may use to follow a keyboard turn. Sent as the acceleration limit on GUIDED_CHANGE_HEADING, which ArduPlane converts back to a bank limit and then clamps to ROLL_LIMIT_DEG.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Turn bank limit

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: altitudeUpKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that raises the target altitude by one step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Climb

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: altitudeDownKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that lowers the target altitude by one step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Descend

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: altitudeStep
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Altitude change per key press. The resulting target is clamped to the Fly View guided minimum and maximum altitudes.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Altitude step

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: altitudeLead
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How far the commanded altitude target may run ahead of where the aircraft actually is. Stops a held key from queueing a descent the aircraft has not started yet.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Maximum target lead

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalPitchUpKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that tilts the gimbal up by one step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Gimbal up

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalPitchDownKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that tilts the gimbal down by one step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Gimbal down

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalPitchStep
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Gimbal pitch change per key press.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Gimbal pitch step

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalYawLeftKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that pans the gimbal left by one step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Gimbal left

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalYawRightKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that pans the gimbal right by one step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Gimbal right

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalYawStep
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Gimbal pan change per key press.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Gimbal pan step

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalNextModeKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that steps forward through the gimbal modes.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Next gimbal mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalPrevModeKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Key that steps back through the gimbal modes.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Previous gimbal mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: modeHotkeysEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Allow single keys to change flight mode. Each press opens a confirmation that a second press of the same key accepts and Esc cancels.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Flight mode hotkeys

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: modeConfirmTimeout
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How long the flight mode confirmation waits for the second key press before cancelling itself.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Confirmation timeout
